text: kho bhikkhave bhikkhu .pe. [209] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . seyyathāpi bhikkhave aciravatī nadī samuddaninnā samuddapoṇā samuddapabbhārā . evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu .pe.
